mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pu_break (student_id, action, reason_type, reason_text, from_year, from_semester, to_year, to_semester, type, status) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{action}, #{reasonType}, #{reasonText}, #{fromYear}, #{fromSemester}, #{toYear}, #{toSemester}, #{reasonType}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pu_break WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY app_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE pu_break SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pu_break WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND action = 'LEAVE' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') AND (from_year * 10 + from_semester) <= (#{toYear} * 10 + #{toSemester}) AND (to_year * 10 + to_semester) >= (#{fromYear} * 10 + #{fromSemester})
SELECT * FROM pu_break WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND action = 'LEAVE' AND status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY app_date DESC LIMIT 1
